$note: Google Fonts reliably available in Figma's font picker — the recommended set for design↔code parity. NOT exhaustive and NOT a gate: any Google Font works on the code side, and the Figma preflight (figma.listAvailableFontsAsync) is the authoritative availability check. An off-list font that this Figma can't render falls back to Inter in the Figma build (logged), while the code side loads it via the Google Fonts <link>.
